title: Bald shin patches and Jack's tumors sent to Air Force pathology institute
place_text: Vermont teaching hospital; Air Force Institute of Pathology near Washington DC

tellings.quote: had tumors growing in the exact spots on his legs.

plain: The story goes that in 1976 a man named Jack Weiner had tumors growing in the exact spots on his legs where bald patches had appeared on his shins, and that tissue from them went from a Vermont teaching hospital to an Air Force pathology institute near Washington DC. A man named Charlie Foltz, who presents himself as a witness to the events, tells this on an episode about alien abduction, passing on what Weiner told him and pointing to a pathology report on the tumor. Told this way, it would suggest the military took a quiet medical interest in the marks left on people who say they were taken.
